summary.text: Refinement path dao marks are law traces of refinement path. Hairy men are born with them, and as natural marks across the five regions and two heavens they form the world's refinement path foundation.

claims.text: Hairy men are born with refinement path dao marks on their bodies, which is why they have talent for Gu refinement. Yu Mu Chun states that refinement path originated from hairy men, with Gu refinement foundations built over eons before human methods rose to dominance.
General dao marks and attainment levels are covered on dao marks and attainment.

Omnipresent four seas is a refinement path killer move that uses Lang Ya blessed land’s refinement path dao marks, Long Hair Ancestor’s lifetime accumulation. It does not spare allies, yet hairy men move freely inside it because they have refinement path dao marks naturally, and their refinement path killer moves are amplified to first-rate rank eight power.
After becoming a refinement path venerable, Fang Yuan begins refining Eastern Sea’s natural refinement path dao marks.

The five regions and two heavens hold a vast but uneven spread of these marks: dense places yield richer refinement path resources, sparse places yield fewer and lower quality ones, and growth is normally extremely slow. Those natural marks are the basis of the world’s refinement path foundation. Once refined, they act like a spider web of refinement path sensation, letting Fang Yuan sense refinement path resources and Gu cultivator refinement activity in range, and interfere with living beings and the environment beyond mere self-amplification.
